verdict.rationale: Token2's documentation shows the keys working across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, and in modern browsers including Chromium-based ones, backed by cross-platform companion and management tools. It also publishes an integration-guides page, but the evidence only shows Microsoft Entra ID and Intune entries rather than a broad catalog of supported services. missing for 10: a published service-compatibility catalog/list, an explicit browser support matrix (e.g. Firefox/Safari), independent hands-on corroboration of cross-OS/browser behavior.

support.subject: As a power user, the key works across my operating systems and browsers, with a published compatibility catalog of supported services

citations.quote: No special tool installation is needed to start using the FIDO keys, as most modern browsers will prompt to set a PIN when required
If you are using macOS or Linux, you can manage your FIDO2 keys using the tool integrated into the latest Chromium based browsers, such as Google Chrome (starting from v80).
You can use the standard Windows control panel tool to manage your key, as long as you run Windows 10 build 1903 or later.
Open-source mobile companion application for configuring and managing FIDO2 security keys on Android and iOS devices.
Automated Registration for Entra ID with PowerShell and GraphAPI
